component.name: GPUBench
component.summary: Modern cross-backend GPU compute and ray tracing benchmark

description.p: GPUBench is a modern, cross-backend GPU compute and hardware-accelerated ray tracing benchmarking utility supporting Vulkan, AMD ROCm/HIP, and OpenCL.

ul.li: Comprehensive floating-point throughput testing (FP64, FP32, FP16, BF16, FP8, FP4, INT8, INT4).
VRAM bandwidth streaming and multi-level cache latency profiling.
Hardware ray tracing traversal, acceleration structure builds/refits, and wavefront scheduling.
Live hardware telemetry including GPU clocks, temperature, power draw, and VRAM utilization.

description.p: Native Vulkan Device-Generated Commands (VK_EXT_device_generated_commands) for ray and path tracing Work Lists with hardware predication, autonomous GPU dispatch, and comprehensive GFX1201 hardware profiling documentation.

Open-world forest scenario with Snell refraction and anisotropic bark, dielectric glass and windshield shader overhaul, master 42-material evaluation suite, hardware-aware VRAM auto-scaling, and multi-scene ray scheduling discovery fix.
Eliminate cross-CU L2 bank contention with 256-byte counter striding, streamline register-to-VRAM wave compaction, and add fair material shading microbenchmarks.
Ray scheduling benchmarks, pinned GUI progress bar, two-column layout, physically-based materials, and comparative rendering grid with explicit resolution annotations.
Added complete GPU profile telemetry embedding in JSON exports, ray scheduling wavefront compaction, and cross-platform desktop integration.
